name: Presa de El Atazar

position.source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/57907223 (OSM waterway=dam outline and line way/288349518; the point of the guided tour, in the plunge pool at the foot of the crown; the downstream face there looks to the centre of the arch, 82.8°)

architects.name: Consulpresa (engineering firm that designed the dam)

rights.note: A modern work (1965/1968–1972) of the Canal de Isabel II (Comunidad de Madrid), designed by Consulpresa and built by Entrecanales y Távora. A dam is an engineering work of mainly functional form; the model is a simplified, illustrative one made from open data (OSM, IGN MDT05) and public photos, with no plans or meshes copied. Flagged for the maintainer as protected.

notes: The model is the dam (Presa de El Atazar, the dam of the Embalse de El Atazar), built by code (model_sources/Q513846_presa_de_el_atazar.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. A double-curvature concrete arch on a circle of about 217 m (to the upstream edge of the crest) spanning 115°, about 425 m of arch plus the straight south wing (≈ 500 m in all; 484 m in the sources): the downstream face shaped after the MDT05 (almost upright at the top, leaning out about 1:9 lower down), with its vertical joints and rust streaks; the upstream face 27 m further upstream at the bed than at the crest (the double curvature; under the water, not measured); the crest at 873.4 m with the road, kerbs, an overhanging cornice, parapets and lamp posts; the fixed-lip spillway at the crown (870 m, 6 piers carrying the road, the lip standing out 3 m); the portal of the two bottom outlets at the foot; the massive north abutment block and the south gravity wing from the OSM outline. y = 0 is the plunge pool at the origin (754.5 m, ground_elev); the crest is 119 m above it, the foundation of the crown about 14 m below. The origin given for the tour (from OSM) is in the plunge pool 36 m downstream of the toe of the face, not on the face itself: the OSM outline reaches further downstream than the face in the MDT05 and the orthophoto. The rock of the gorge is drawn around the dam downstream and on the abutments (a rock skirt following the MDT05 with the dam taken out; its rim dips 20 m into the ground), with pines on the slopes below; the reservoir side is left open (the water is drawn by the game). ground: keep with ground_fit false. Uncertain: the upstream face (±10 m), the exact length and bays of the spillway (±10 m), the shape of the abutment blocks below the crest, the intake tower and the powerhouse (not modelled). Note: the MDT05 (and so terrain.json) carries the downstream face as a steep slope; with ground_fit false the game does not cut it, so near the foot of the face the detailed terrain may show a few metres in front of the model.
